function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.vendor_id, pl.sku, pl.period, pl.unit_price_orig, pl.contract_unit_price, pl.qty, pl.fx_rate,
       (pl.unit_price_orig - pl.contract_unit_price) * pl.qty * pl.fx_rate AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
WHERE v.vendor_name = 'VEND-SNC'
  AND pl.sku IN ('NUT-ALM', 'NUT-CAS', 'NUT-PEC')
  AND pl.period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
ORDER BY pl.period, pl.sku","purpose":"Check unit price vs contract price for VEND-SNC and specific SKUs"}
